Maya (CSM): quick heads up — HorizonLabs flagged a potential shift across three teams to embeddings + rerank and long-context summarization. asking about capacity and cost impacts. estimated peak qps ~400 (from current ~60). they want hosted for speed but asked about SLA. @Omar any quick guidance?
Omar (Solutions Eng): thanks — rough thought: embeddings + rerank for search will jump token throughput (esp. rerank in 2-stage). do we know model family they prefer? ftw if they use a 2k context vs 32k matters a lot.
Maya (CSM): customer said: search team (realtime queries), support team (summaries + convo embeddings), analytics team (batch rerank). they mentioned trying an open M-family (quantized) and also evaluating a hosted variant. peak pattern: 400 qps spikes for 2h/day, steady 120 qps off-peak.
Liam (Success Ops): ok — operational checklist: 1) propose a Dedicated pilot (reserve a small pool) 2) suggest prefix caching for support workflows 3) run a cost estimate + SLA delta. I can spin up a draft quote spreadsheet — need model/seq len assumptions.
Nora (PM): also flagging product risk: if we switch rerank model variants late, we need canary + rollback plan. can we set automatic fallback to smaller model under load?
Omar (Solutions Eng): yes, routing policy + fallback works. example snippet for policy: 
````
route_policy: 
  - priority: region_local
  - fallback: model-small-quant
autoscale: 
  target_qps: 400
  buffer: 0.15
cache: 
  prefix_kv: true
````
This will limit cold-starts and keep latency stable. also recommend 8-bit quant for embeddings to cut cost.
Maya (CSM): perfect. i'll book a joint call w/ HorizonLabs Tue 10am PT. can someone own the cost estimate + proposal? @Liam can you take cost + reserve numbers, @Omar can draft the routing + fallback?
Liam (Success Ops): taking cost + reserve. will post spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow and tag this thread. :thumbsup:
Omar (Solutions Eng): will draft routing + perf expectations and include a short checklist for eval metrics (p95 latency, token cost, quality delta).
